statement: This sketch depicts a continuous, flowing accumulation of falling letters that gradually form coherent words. Letters drift downward from the top of the screen under the influence of gravity and gentle wind, bouncing off each other through cohesion and separation forces. As they settle, they naturally cluster together to form readable words, creating a visual metaphor for language emerging from chaos. The process is perpetual—new letters continuously fall while existing ones accumulate and group into meaningful formations, resulting in an ever-changing landscape of linguistic snow that fills the canvas over time.
